title: The seventh rank
line: A rook on the seventh attacks pawns and boxes in the king.

steps.text: Black's pawns start on the seventh rank, the second row from Black's side. Pawns standing on one row cannot guard each other.
Put your rook on the seventh rank.
steps.hint: The rook goes straight up its file.
steps.after: Black's rook comes back to guard a pawn.

steps.text: Tap every black pawn your rook attacks now.

wrong.a7: Another pawn stands in the way.
wrong.g7: Another pawn stands in the way.
wrong.h7: Other pawns stand in the way.

steps.hint: Look along the row your rook stands on, both ways.
steps.after: Black's rook and king are tied to guarding them, and the king has no square off its back row.

steps.text: Two rooks on the seventh are stronger still. Bring your other rook up beside the first.

wrong.g2g3: That gives Black time to bring a rook over and trade off yours on the seventh.

steps.after: Black's king steps into the corner. It has no way off its back row.

steps.text: Take the pawn on g7. Your other rook guards it along the row.
steps.after: A pawn up, and both rooks still on the seventh, next to the boxed-in king.

summary: A rook on the seventh rank attacks pawns from the side and keeps the king on its back row. Two rooks there do more.
